Name: Dino Expanded
Author: Amichwan
Description:
[u][b][size=6]Dino Expanded[/size][/b][/u]
[size=4]Dino Expanded is a mod that completely reinvents dinosaurs in Stardew Valley, turning them into a full gameplay path with new species, buildings, machines, items, clothing, and progression.[/size]

[u][b][size=5]Main Features[/size][/b][/u]

• 5 new dinosaur species, each with unique products
• A new dinosaur building with 3 upgrade levels
• 2 new machines: the [b]Genetic Fuser[/b] and the [b]Dinosaur Incubator[/b]
• New dinosaur-based animal products and processed goods
• New clothing and 3 new boots
• Optional special boot buffs via dependency
• Custom dinosaur sound effects
• Full in-game progression through letters and quests
• English and Spanish translations included

[b][size=5]Dinosaurs[/size][/b]

Dino Expanded adds [b]five new dinosaur types[/b], each with its own characteristics:
(I based them on real dinosaurs and designed them in a style that I think suits the logic and art of Vanilla. I also used edible things in the names, following the Pepper Rex theme.)

• Zippy Eggplant (Velociraptor)
• Pepper Rex (Stegosaurus) – vanilla dinosaur
• Corn Horn (Triceratops
• Ladle Neck (Brachiosaurus)
• Chili Chomp (Tyrannosaurus Rex)
• Fin Tart (Spinosaurus)

[b]Important note for existing saves:[/b]
If you already have a vanilla dinosaur in a Coop when installing this mod, it will begin to grow and produce normally. However, if the Coop door is opened, the dinosaur will attempt to leave, become stuck in an inaccessible area, and may stop eating or producing.

[b]Recommendation:[/b]
Sell any vanilla dinosaurs before opening Coop doors, as dinosaurs cannot be relocated to a different building from the one they were born in.

[b][size=5]Dino Hutch (New Building)[/size][/b]

A new building designed exclusively for dinosaurs.

• Includes [b]3 upgrade levels[/b]; each upgrade adds a new incubator
• Allows raising all dinosaur types added by this mod
• Animal capacity matches vanilla buildings: 4 (Basic), 8 (Big), 12 (Deluxe)
• Option for [b]clean interior maps[/b] (no hay on the floor, no decorative clutter, fixed walls and floors) or the normal version
• Required to incubate dinosaur eggs
• Deluxe upgrade is paintable
• An optional config setting provides a lighter sprite for painting, since the default darker sprite does not recolor well (Recommended to enable only when painting the building)

[size=4][b]Unlocking the Dino Hutch:[/b][/size]

• Donate a Dinosaur Egg to the Museum
• Claim the reward (another Dinosaur Egg)
• The next day, you will receive a letter from Gunther
• After that, Robin will be able to construct the Dino Hutch

[b][size=5]Quest & Progression[/size][/b]

[spoiler]

•After building your first Dino Hutch, you will receive a letter from [b]Demetrius[/b] with a special research quest.
He will ask for a Dinosaur Egg. Genetic Fuser recipe (received by letter the following day)

•After building your first [b]Big Dino Hutch[/b], you will receive a letter from [b]Marlon[/b] unlocking the purchase of special boots in his shop.

•After building your first Dino Hutch, you will also receive a letter from [b]Demetrius[/b] with the recipe for the Dinosaur Incubator.
To receive this recipe, the Demetrius quest must be completed.

[size=4][b]Important progression rules:[/b][/size]

If you upgrade directly to the Deluxe Dino Hutch before completing Demetrius’ quest: You will receive the Genetic Fuser recipe after completing the quest. The Dinosaur Incubator recipe will arrive by letter the following day[/spoiler]

[b][size=5]New Machines[/size][/b]

[size=4][b]Genetic Fuser[/b][/size]
An advanced machine used to create specialized dinosaur eggs.

• Only accepts Dinosaur Eggs
• Two balance modes available:

[b]Normal Mode[/b]
[spoiler]

• Zippy Eggplant Egg
Dinosaur Egg + Skeletal Hand
Dinosaur Egg + Hoof

• Fin Tart Egg
Dinosaur Egg + Prehistoric Scapula
Dinosaur Egg + Epibiont

• Corn Horn Egg
XXL Dinosaur Egg + Prehistoric Rib
XXL Dinosaur Egg + Horn

• Ladle Neck Egg
XXL Dinosaur Egg + Skeletal Tail
XXL Dinosaur Egg + Refined Scale

• Chili Chomp Egg
XXL Dinosaur Egg + Prehistoric Skull
XXL Dinosaur Egg + Claw

• You can also place one XXL Dinosaur Egg to obtain 2 normal Dinosaur Eggs[/spoiler]

[b]Easy Mode[/b]
[spoiler]

• Zippy Eggplant Egg
Dinosaur Egg + 5 Eggplants

• Fin Tart Egg
Dinosaur Egg + 1 Pink Cake

• Corn Horn Egg
XXL Dinosaur Egg + 10 Corn

• Ladle Neck Egg
XXL Dinosaur Egg + 20 Blueberries

• Chili Chomp Egg
XXL Dinosaur Egg + 15 Hot Peppers

• You can also place one XXL Dinosaur Egg to obtain 2 normal Dinosaur Eggs[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Dinosaur Incubator[/b][/size]

A specialized incubator for dinosaur eggs.

• Only functions inside the Dino Hutch
(it can be placed in other interiors, but will not work outside the Dino Hutch)
• Accepts all dinosaur egg types
• Incubation time is shorter than the incubators included in the building

[b][size=5]New Animal Products & Processing[/size][/b]

Dinosaurs produce unique items, some of which can be processed using vanilla machines.

[size=4][b]Dinosaur Production[/b][/size]
[spoiler]

• Zippy Eggplant – produces daily
Normal product: Feather
Deluxe product: Hoof

• Pepper Rex – produces every 3 days
Normal product: Dinosaur Egg
Deluxe product: Plate and XXL Dinosaur Egg

• Fin Tart – produces daily
Normal product: Epibiont (must go outside to produce)

• Corn Horn – produces every 7 days
Normal product: Corn Horn Corn

• Ladle Neck – produces every 2 days
Normal product: Scales (must be harvested with shears)

• Chili Chomp – produces every 4 days
Normal product: Claw
Deluxe product: Nodule[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Product Processing[/b][/size]
[spoiler]

• Feather → Loom → Fine Thread
• XXL Dinosaur Egg → Mayonnaise Machine → Dinosaur Mayonnaise (x2)
• Epibiont → Dehydrator → Deluxe Bait (30–45)
• Horn → Recycler → Bone Fragments (50–100)
• Dinosaur Scales → Furnace → Refined Scales (1–4)
• Nodules → Oil Maker → Nodule Extract[/spoiler]

All processing uses existing vanilla machines, keeping the mod fully integrated into normal gameplay.

[b][size=5]Clothing & Boots[/size][/b]

[size=4][b]Dinosaur Shirt[/b][/size]
• Dinosaur-themed shirt completing the dinosaur outfit
• Crafted using Pepper Rex production materials
[spoiler]
Plate[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]New Boots (3 types)[/b][/size]
• Two configuration modes: with buffs or without buffs
• Buffs require the optional dependency listed in Requirements

[b]Boots with Buffs[/b]
[spoiler]

Scale Boots
Immunity: 8
Defense: 9

Claw Boots
Immunity: 5
Defense: 7
Buff: +5 Attack

Hoof Boots
Immunity: 7
Defense: 4
Buff: +3 Speed[/spoiler]

[b]Boots without Buffs[/b]
[spoiler]

Scale Boots
Immunity: 5
Defense: 12

Claw Boots
Immunity: 10
Defense: 5

Hoof Boots
Immunity: 7
Defense: 7[/spoiler]

[b][size=4]Sound Effects[/size][/b]

All dinosaurs include custom sound effects.
• Sounds can be enabled or disabled globally via configuration.

[b][size=4]Configuration[/size][/b]

This mod supports the [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].

You can configure:
• Genetic Fuser egg crafting difficulty
• Enable or disable dinosaur sounds
• Clean or normal interior maps
• Alternate sprite for painting the Deluxe upgrade
• Enable or disable boot buffs

[b][size=5]Updates[/size][/b]

[b]1.0.4[/b]
• A recipe for placing scales in the heavy furnace has been added.
• The option to add mod products to the Civic Center and Theater bundles has been added, compatible with SVE. (Only valid when starting a new game)
• Secret Notes have been added; the framework is required, otherwise they will be omitted.
• Some sprite details have been corrected.

[b]1.0.2[/b]
• Added a new progression requirements option to provide alternate unlock conditions when letters or quests fail to trigger, allowing players to continue progression at the cost of immersion.

[b]1.0.1[/b]
• Added an option to configure whether donating a Dinosaur Egg to the Museum and receiving the letter is required to build the Dino Hutch.
• Added an option to exclude dinosaur products and their artisan goods from Perfection requirements.


[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]

Designed to be compatible with most mods.
Mods that directly modify the vanilla dinosaur may cause conflicts.

[b][size=5]Translations[/size][/b]

• English (EN)
• Spanish (ES)

I am a native Spanish speaker. Any corrections to the English translation are greatly appreciated, and additional translations are very welcome!
